verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs clearly describe reserved instances that let users pre-pay for GPU time to lock in up to 50% discounts versus on-demand pricing, and any on-demand instance can be converted to reserved at any time. This directly matches the platform-engineer story of committing to sustained capacity for a discount. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of actual discount realization, no detail on committed-use terms/duration, cancellation policy, or enterprise-scale reserved-capacity contracts beyond per-instance conversion.
